title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E06 — The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E01 — Desert Beginnings
DIYer Rachel Metz heads to the desert to claim her first-ever solo home; Rachel tours her Joshua Tree ranch and begins transforming the fixer-upper into a dream homestead, starting with a custom bed frame built from wood stumps found on her new land.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E02 — Concrete Chaos & Joshua Tree Charm
Rachel tackles her first official guest bedroom makeover, where she finds her flow with a custom plant wall; when a layout snag changes her plans, she pivots to build an integrated headboard and a floating bed that lights up the desert night.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E03 — Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

title: Living to DIY With Rachel Metz
description:
S01 E04 — Living With Leo
Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E01 — Mystery Unlocked
Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E02 — Raising the Bar
On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation
Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen
Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E05 — Designed to Dine
Bo and Kyle build a 12-foot banquette clad in salvaged white oak parquet flooring, paired with an elm table and vintage restaurant chairs to create a dining nook; they start their largest project to date: designing a massive backyard oasis.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E06 — The Backyard Blueprint
Bo and Kyle take a trip to Michigan Tile & Marble, to source salvaged stone, pavers and granite remnants for their outdoor space; Bo maps out curved gravel pathways while Kyle pours the concrete pad for the future outdoor kitchen.

title: The Reveal
description:
S06 E01 — It's a Mood: Cara Woodhouse's Noyack Cottage
Step inside Noyack Cottage, a stunning Sag Harbor vacation home transformed by Cara Woodhouse; known for her emotionally resonant environments, Cara blends bold forms, layered textures, and a joyful color palette to create a cozy cottage experience.

title: The Reveal
description: This is the moment every designer loves and no client ever forgets; it's the moment when a home is complete, the design work is finished, and the transformation is ready to be unveiled.

title: The Reveal
description:
S04 E11 — Modern & Minimal South End Makeover
Leia T. Ward transforms a traditional home into a modern, open floor plan with elevated style.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E01 — Redesign Your Life
The possibilities to redesign your life are endless; Sabrina gets inspired by expert insights from Lewis Howes, Catherine McCord's meal prep ideas, and planting tips from Justina Blakeney; get ready to refresh your space, plate, and perspective!

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E04 — The High Low Life
Trainer Keon Dorsey brings the burn, stylist Caroline Baudino shows how to look ultra-chic on a budget, and journalist Natalie Morales wraps it up with an impressive, budget-friendly dinner you can make in no time.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E06 — Design Your Life, Build Your Wealth, Love Your Skin
Small changes can create a big ripple effect in your daily life; Pattie Ehsaei tackles the tricky topic of finances, Bobby Berk steps in to transform Sabrina's most high-traffic home spaces, and Dr. Sugai spills pro tips and beauty secrets.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:

Dr. Steven Storage explores supplements and brain health, Ingrid Clay delivers a longevity-focused workout, and Danny Morel dives into transformative breathwork and the art of surrender; it's a personal journey to wellness from the inside out.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E02 — Hocking Hills Hideaways
Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E04 — Innovation and Inlets
Levi explores the Sunshine State to find unique stays; he starts in Orlando at the Micro House, the state's first 3D-printed micro home; then, he heads to Key Largo to board Stay Ombi, a floating bungalow anchored in Buttonwood Sound.

description:
S01 E01 — Mystery Unlocked
Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E02 — Raising the Bar
On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E03 — Rust, Relics and Relaxation
Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

title: Woodward Throwbacks
description:
S01 E04 — The Reclaimed Kitchen
Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

title: Design Science
description:
The Science Behind Kitchens & Bedrooms
Designer Julie Couch takes on the science of transforming spaces.

title: Design Science
description:
The Formula for Small Spaces & Outdoor Living
Designer Julie Couch transforms everything from small rooms to outdoor spaces.

title: Design Science
description:
The Principles of Space Planning
Designer Julie Couch breaks down the basic formulas for successful design.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E02 — Rustic Meets Refined
Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E04 — Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E06 — The Cutest DIY Play Closet Ever
Kylie tackles her own home and creates a whimsical movie room and play closet designed especially for her daughters; the once-cluttered space transforms into a magical room built for family movie nights, creativity and playtime adventures.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E03 — This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale
Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

title: DIY House Call With Kylie Katich
description:
S01 E01 — We Turned a Blank Room Into a Dream Studio
Kylie Katich helps her best friend Hayley turn her blank room into a warm, personality-packed podcast studio; from custom curtain tracks and gallery walls to cozy furniture, the makeover gives Hayley a space that finally feels completely her own.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E04 — Melba Wilson: A Harlem Icon
Chef, restaurateur, and author Melba Wilson schools Matthew on the art of her legendary shrimp and grits; with laughter, flavor, and zero room for dessert, this visit is an unforgettable taste of Harlem's finest and most original.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E05 — Burgers and Babka: Viral Sensations
Matthew meets two culinary trailblazers; first, he visits Matthew McIvor, the genius behind Proudly Serving's legendary smashburger and then dives into the art of babka with the one and only King of Babka himself, Chef Shimi Aaron.

title: Fame to Table
description:
S01 E06 — Fariyal Abdullahi: From Ethiopia to the Met Gala
Matthew meets culinary powerhouse and Ethiopian-born Chef Fariyal Abdullahi for an exclusive tour of Hav & Mar, the sizzling seafood spot where she is the Executive Chef and gets a hands-on lesson in creating their signature dish, Doro Wat.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E08 — European Getaway in the Heart of Tennessee
Travel to Tennessee to step inside the stunning European-inspired home of designer and antique curator Lauren Sullivan; this estate seamlessly blends classic architecture with a soulful collection of family heirlooms and historical treasures.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E10 — A Converted Boathouse Becomes a Beautiful Home on Nantucket
Step inside designer Gary McBournie and Bill Richards's Nantucket oceanside escape; see the boat shed transformed into a breezy summer sanctuary perfect for entertaining; every corner is infused with a sophisticated yet delightful nautical flair.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E02 — Container Homes: All Shapes and Sizes
Jillian discovers two homeowners who have taken containers-and creativity-to extraordinary new heights; Sean's property is a sprawling estate crafted from five containers and Kylie is in the middle of building a massive yoga retreat.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E03 — Off-Grid Living: The Creative Space
Jillian dives headfirst into an off-grid dream when she meets Chris at his one-of-a-kind Quonset hut in Joshua Tree and gets a crash course in living off the beaten path-without sacrificing style.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E05 — From Cats to Co-Living: A Place for Everyone
Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E06 — Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

title: Alt Home
description:
S01 E01 — Living in Art: Kaleidoscopic Homes
Imagine stepping into a kaleidoscope, where colors, shapes, and textures collide; that's exactly what Jillian experiences as she explores the iconic Mosaic Tile House in beachy, boho Venice and the Rainbow House in the desert oasis of Palm Springs.

Kylie transforms Mike and Tay's unfinished workout room into a sleek, motivating home gym complete with smart storage solutions; what starts with Grinch-green walls becomes a bright, elevated space built for serious workouts and serious style.

description:
S01 E02 — Margot & Josh's Teal Transformation
Margot and Josh spent years perfecting every room in the house but overlooked the bedroom they use daily; Drew steps in with some bedroom inspiration, transforming their space on a series of creative dates.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E04 — Eduardo & Gabriela's Guest Retreat
Eduardo and Gabriela's "little" home projects have piled up; with their grown son's room ready to become a guest retreat, an unfinished wallpaper job in the laundry room, and shades waiting to be hung, they're ready for Drew's help.

title: Date My House
description:
S01 E06 — Kayla & Ryan's Toddler To-Do List
Kayla and Ryan are managing a newborn and a toddler, plus the aftermath of tornado damage, which means they need both functionality and style in their space; Drew jumps in, delivering the family-friendly upgrades that they desperately need.

description:
S01 E09 — An Eclectic Brooklyn Townhouse Defined by Fashion
Travel to Brooklyn to visit the vibrant townhouse of multidisciplinary artists Skylar Marshai and Temi Ibisanmi; featuring a vinyl room, curated treasures and a striking collection of artwork, every space reflects their eye for fashion and color.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E02 — Home of a Design Icon: The Country Home & Gardens of Bunny Williams
Bunny Williams opens the doors to her 1860s Falls Village estate; explore a rustic barn filled with antiques and an A-frame studio reimagined as a modern retreat; the tour concludes at the Greek temple-inspired pool house crafted from tree trunks.

title: Homeworthy: The Collection
description:
S01 E03 — An English-Inspired Home With a Farm in New Jersey
In New Jersey, antique enthusiast Caley Svensson has transformed a former Italian-Tuscany style residence into an English countryside haven; it is a charming reimagining of suburban acreage where history and family life coexist.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description: Join Sabrina Soto for a vibrant and inspiring show dedicated to transforming every aspect of your life.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E04 — The High Low Life
Trainer Keon Dorsey brings the burn, stylist Caroline Baudino shows how to look ultra-chic on a budget, and journalist Natalie Morales wraps it up with an impressive, budget-friendly dinner you can make in no time.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E07 — Whole Body, Mind & Spirit
Dr. Steven Storage explores supplements and brain health, Ingrid Clay delivers a longevity-focused workout, and Danny Morel dives into transformative breathwork and the art of surrender; it's a personal journey to wellness from the inside out.

title: The Sabrina Soto Show
description:
S01 E08 — Cocina De Sabrina
Chef Marcela brings the flavor with a vibrant, healthy dish, designer Breegan Jane proves that fridge-scaping is here to stay, and Dr. Nigma Talib shares game-changing skin and gut health tips.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
A Tiny Frame of Mind; Tiny Cabin & Caboose
In Ohio, Levi visits Pinnacle A-Frame and The Wren at Hillside Amble; heading to Virginia for a look at James Station Caboose, a nearly 40-foot-long caboose-turned-tiny-home.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E02 — Hocking Hills Hideaways
Levi heads to Ohio to explore two modern studio cabins; Star Meadow in Logan is a serene sanctuary designed for nature lovers; Levi visits The Everwoods Alpine, a romantic escape that mixes contemporary design with a deep forest feel.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E04 — Innovation and Inlets
Levi explores the Sunshine State to find unique stays; he starts in Orlando at the Micro House, the state's first 3D-printed micro home; then, he heads to Key Largo to board Stay Ombi, a floating bungalow anchored in Buttonwood Sound.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E06 — Geometric Gems and Storybook Stays
Levi explores two whimsical retreats plucked straight from a fairytale; he starts in Rising Fawn at the Laurel Zome, a stunning geometric dome; then Levi discovers the Merry Mushroom, a charming tiny home designed to resemble woodland fungi.

title: Tiny BNB
description:
S06 E08 — Ridge-Top Rituals and Riverfront Rejuvenation
In Rockbridge, Ohio, Levi tours The Pine at Dunlap Ridge which features a wall of windows that overlooks towering pines and farmland; then in Newry, Maine, Levi discovers The Cabin at Bear River, a luxurious escape inspired by Japandi design.
